script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

TITLE: LOVE A.I.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

A room filled with the hum of computers and the smell of coffee. JANE, 30, a brilliant programmer, sits in front of a massive computer, surrounded by her team.

JANE
(addressing team)
We have one more adjustment to make on "Amor," our new AI dating app.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

EMMA, 28, a successful marketing executive, sits on her couch, scrolling through dating apps. She sighs, frustrated.

EMMA
(to herself)
Another day, another disappointing match.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

Jane's team finishes the adjustment, and they all cheer. Jane looks pleased.

JANE
(into microphone)
Amor is now ready for launch.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Emma sits at a table, sipping coffee, and checking her phone. A notification catches her eye.

EMMA
(reading aloud)
"New match: Ethan."

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

ETHAN, 29, a charming graphic designer, receives a notification on his phone. He looks intrigued.

ETHAN
(to himself)
Another new match on Amor. Let's see.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Emma and Ethan meet for the first time. They share a laugh over their mutual love for old movies.

EMMA
I've never met someone who knows so much about classic cinema.

ETHAN
(smiling)
The same can be said for me about modern marketing techniques.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

Jane watches as the number of new users on Amor increases.

JANE
(to herself)
It's working. People are connecting through our app.

INT. ART GALLERY - DAY

Emma and Ethan explore an art gallery, pointing out their favorite pieces and sharing stories about their lives. They laugh and smile, their connection growing stronger.

ETHAN
(looking at a painting)
This reminds me of you.

EMMA
(surprised)
Really? How so?

ETHAN
(pointing to the painting)
See the way the colors blend together, creating something beautiful? That's what you do for me.

INT. STUDIO - NIGHT

Jane receives a message from Amor. A high number of users have reported successful matches and romantic connections. She smiles, proud of her creation.

JANE
(to herself)
Love A.I. is truly making a difference in people's lives.

INT. PARK - DAY

Emma and Ethan sit on a bench, holding hands and enjoying the sunshine. They share their dreams and aspirations, and Ethan tells her that he's fallen in love with her.

EMMA
(teary-eyed)
I think I've fallen in love with you, too.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

Jane sits in front of her computer, staring at the screen, a smile on her face. She's happy knowing that her creation has brought two people together.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
